plain_statement.zh: 精确计算距离最优下界 δ 以内的偶目标所占比例的一阶常数。
plain_statement.en: Find the first-order lower-tail density at the sharp floor.

brief.zh: #4275 用二的幂说明下界可逼近；本题预测比例约为 2e^(−γ)/log(1/δ)。避开至约 1/δ 的奇素数产生 Mertens 因子，须在这个筛过的样本内估计更大素因子的贡献，并按先 N 后 δ 的次序取极限。
brief.en: Powers of two give witnesses in #4275. For the frequency, sieve out odd prime factors up to scale 1/δ, then bound the conditional tail from larger primes. The order of limits is N first, δ second.
